authoritativeBaseline.userMeaning: 该页面旧曲面人物是最贴近的外观；并非确认旧结构已满足自然动作、全角度和物理要求

measurements.method: Snapshot module graph instantiated in Node; metadata-only textures, no pixel render, no browser and no new model/art asset.

coordinates.scale: Uncalibrated local study units; do not silently reinterpret as physical metres.

canonicalStaticState.note: 4348 normally runs idle over elapsed time; canonical manual/full/t0 freezes the same neutral identity for numerical comparison. Its head is y=1.1, not y=1.088.

sourceGraph.warning: app.js 16 degree perspective fitting and stage.js floor are not mounted by the 4348 entry; do not copy them as the approved camera.

lockedNeutralAppearance.primaryRule: Keep the existing visible front XYZ, source UV and painted material, then add structure behind it. For a remesh, transfer both positions/UV and enforce the frozen projection landmarks; do not fit a generic new face.
notOnlySilhouette: Eye upper/lower curves, unequal iris sizes and aperture offsets
Short asymmetric chin and existing cheek width/profile
Hair lock contours, face occlusions, blue bows, white frill and hook ahoge
Current body/leg proportions and the asymmetric two-fluke tail contour
Original pixels, vertex tint, unlit front shading, alpha/depth behavior
Orthographic framing, node transforms and actual bind-vs-neutral bone matrices
lockedNeutralAppearance.preserveXYZRatherThanOnlyXYReason: The accepted model already has curved front depth; changing Z changes the accepted oblique identity even when the frontal orthographic XY projection remains fixed.

doNotSymmetrize.eyes: Left/right iris radii and aperture curves are different, intentionally following the cover.
doNotSymmetrize.primaryHair: Left/right original-cover contours are separately traced.
doNotSymmetrize.bodyMirror: Right sleeve/hand/leg source uses 1156-px, a mirror axis at image px578, not the source mapping origin580.
doNotSymmetrize.auxiliaryLongCurls: These already mirror one approved left auxiliary trace; preserve this existing behavior rather than replacing it.

ordinaryUVNotFrameSwitch.fact: Original raster images are normal UV textures on continuously deformed 3D geometry. No whole-character billboard, per-action full-image replacement or video generation is used by this baseline.
ordinaryUVNotFrameSwitch.limitation: A normal UV texture does not itself certify physical topology, authored side/rear identity, articulated fingers or realistic contact.

uses: Original iris pupil and highlights, sampled together
Narrow inferred crown extension reusing top blue pixels

garment.role: Approved auxiliary original painting for body, long curls and ahoge; not a scan or independent side/back truth.
garment.bodyFrontOnlyTextureRule: Source pixels are assigned to forward groups. Inferred side/back groups use authored plain colors. No alpha cutout supplies body volume closure.

localXY: x=(px-582)/340 for left, x negated for right

rearAuxiliary.role: Inferred safe blue rear-head region and side depth guide; not user-approved new anatomy.

runtimeSampling.godotOrGLTFVAdaptation: If retaining raw source UV and original image bytes, apply vSample=1-v once at the runtime sampler boundary, or a documented equivalent texture transform. Never flip both exported UV and sampler again.
runtimeSampling.frontMaterials: MeshBasicMaterial / unlit, toneMapped=false; output sRGB without a new tone mapper or generic cel repaint.
dynamicFaceCautions: Gaze changes UV arrays, not only vertex position.
Eyelid and mouth skin annuli use dynamically updated RGBA vertex alpha and depthWrite=false.
Iris/white visibility near complete blink and tongue visibility are local occlusion optimizations, not whole-image action switching.
Auxiliary hair/frill can combine blend transparency and alphaTest; ordinary glTF MASK versus BLEND alone is not exact.

faceContract.leftContourRule: Mirror the sampled right contour, then add .046*smooth(clamp((-y-.1)/.282)) to X below the cheek. Preserve the current sampled edges, not a newly evaluated generic oval.

reference.role: Generated auxiliary side view used only to estimate hidden depth
reference.uncertainty: Approximate skin-contour observations; hair occludes the forehead and rear jaw. Absolute depth and camera yaw are inferred, not measured.

parameterHelp.strength: 0 retains the previous depth; 1 uses this candidate. Start side QA at .65, then compare 1.
parameterHelp.noseProjection: Additional nose depth in local units; suggested tuning range -.025 to +.025.
parameterHelp.lipProjection: Additional lip depth; suggested tuning range -.020 to +.020.
parameterHelp.chinProjection: Advances the entire lower closing jaw and seam together; suggested -.040 to +.040.
parameterHelp.noseCenterX: Align the 3D nose with the original painted nose, approximately local X +.066.
parameterHelp.lipCenterX: Original painted mouth axis, approximately local X +.035.
parameterHelp.noseWidth: Nose deformation falloff width; suggested .075 to .120. Does not widen X/Y geometry.
parameterHelp.lipWidth: Lower-face feature falloff width; suggested .130 to .190.
parameterHelp.cheekExponent: Lateral cheek curvature; .25 retains the current upper-face cross section.

frontalInvariants: Original UV coordinates and reference pixels
Existing eye/mouth apertures and dynamic topology
integration: Create this volume with the original widthAt/centerAt functions.
Use frontZ for every existing face layer; keep current per-layer Z offsets and alpha seam blend.
Use backZ in backGeometry, retaining its existing X/Y rows. Both edges use boundaryZ.
Recompute changed geometry bounds/normals. Keep scalp geometry independently volumetric.
limitations: Auxiliary side depth is inferred and has not passed rendered 90° QA.
Perspective projection can change apparent frontal size after Z edits even though geometric X/Y and UV are unchanged.
This only closes the face shell. It does not fix scalp, hair, ear or body side topology.

implementation.interpolation: linear precomputed sections; exact silhouette evaluation near boundary

faceContract.currentStructure: Curved front shell with 2 eye holes and a mouth hole plus a rounded back skull meeting at the silhouette. Separate dynamically deformed surface annuli/strips/fans complete the visible face; they are not a single welded eyelid/oral topology.
faceContract.eyeVolumeLimit: White and iris are curved surface patches following faceSurfaceZ, not separate closed eye globes/socket cavities.
faceContract.oralVolumeLimit: The object called mouth cavity is a front curved colored fan, not a deep closed oral cavity with lining.

volumeAudit.bodyInterpretation: All 13 body parts are individually closed after positional welding. They are capped overlapping parts, not continuous anatomy across neck/shoulder/wrist/hip. Closed render solids must not be blindly used as a solid skirt collider.
volumeAudit.hands: Each hand is one biconvex traced whole-hand volume bound to one wrist bone, no individual digit bones.
volumeAudit.tail: Tubular stem and two separately closed biconvex flukes, 0.10 nominal fin thickness with 0.004 rim; pieces are not a welded fork branch. Keep these approved source contours in any structural integration.
volumeAudit.skirt: A 29x96 capped continuous section volume with painted apron/frill; the apron is not an independently simulated cloth layer. True hollow garment/petticoat and tail opening remain structural work.

volumeAudit.hairInterpretation: Scalp and rear waterfall are true closed volumes. Source-painted locks have front/side/back surfaces but adaptive subdivision and T-junctions prevent treating every closed-thickness label as a certified simulation manifold. Headband ends are open.
volumeAudit.methodLimits: Position-weld topology statistics are not signed-solid, self-intersection or deformation acceptance.

at25: Actual head geometry rotates continuously; body counterturn is only 10 percent opposite yaw.
The front paint and attached curves retain identity, but head shell/eye depth and side hair seams still require actual render review.
The current range is an implementation allowance, not proof that every expression/occlusion at both signs has passed.
at90: Current head control cannot reach 90; it clamps to 25. A camera orbit or whole-root turn is a separate diagnostic.
Near-side eyes/eyelashes/lips remain thin layered surfaces on the original curved front, without fully integrated socket/oral depth.
Scalp side and body volume exist, but many visible side surfaces are inferred plain colors or patch edges, not authored artwork continuation.
Profile depth comes from an approximate generated auxiliary image with installed strength .65 and validatedAt90Degrees=false.
rear: Rear hair samples a limited generated blue region and stretches it over the waterfall volume.
Bodice/sleeves/legs/shoes/skirt rear colors are inferred solids; back silhouette/paint has not been identity-accepted.
Closed separate parts, unsolved intersections and incomplete physical collisions remain; a closed back alone is not all-angle anatomy.

implementationRecommendation.action: Finish a faithful static source transfer first
implementationRecommendation.invariants: Same source geometry, UV, materials, texture bytes, orthographic camera and skin/head hierarchy. Compare front neutral pixels/landmarks in the old page and new runtime before adding anything.
implementationRecommendation.avoid: No normalization to a different head/body ratio, symmetric face fitting, new eye shader, new hair design or native-v2/v3/v4 doll substitution.

implementationRecommendation.action: Retain the approved front surface, complete hidden anatomical structure behind it
implementationRecommendation.method: Trace actual front boundary loops and align new hidden cross-sections with their tangents. Build coherent C1 side/back volume and joint rings; weld/retopologize openings with shared weights rather than thicken an entire drawing into a stack of plates. Constrain neutral front XYZ/UV and canonical projected landmarks during fitting.
implementationRecommendation.checks: Exact frozen front placement/paint retained; shared-edge orientation, closed or intentionally open garment boundaries, positive local solids and no self-intersections.

implementationRecommendation.action: Integrate eye and mouth deformation without replacing their drawings
implementationRecommendation.method: Use the existing aperture/iris/lash/lip traces as master curves. Add hidden socket/eye-lens and oral lining volumes, continuous lid/lip skin loops and corrective deformations that meet those same traces. Preserve original iris UV/pupil/highlights and current gaze UV behavior; transfer alpha transitions deliberately.
implementationRecommendation.checks: Neutral front identical; continuous blink, speech and gaze across both yaw signs; no sprite swapping or layer popping.

implementationRecommendation.action: Turn the existing body and hair into deformable physical structures
implementationRecommendation.method: Keep visible fitted garment/hand/tail contours and UV. Add continuous hidden body at the joints and real articulated digits behind the approved hand surface. Make skirt a hollow cloth shell with an inner garment and a tail exit matching the original tail route/appearance. Weld curved hair surfaces and create strand chains/contact volumes inside the same locks.
implementationRecommendation.checks: Bone lengths/attachments fixed, joint limits, live cloth/contact and tail/hair response; source-front visual invariants must still hold.

implementationRecommendation.action: Review increasing angles and then a continuous contact sequence
implementationRecommendation.method: Freeze front acceptance first, then compare both signs at 15/25/45/90 degrees and rear using actual rendered views. Add view-conditioned anime corrective geometry only from the locked identity. Finally test turn, step, reach/grip and stop with actual support contacts.
implementationRecommendation.avoid: Do not label an index closure test, a single front screenshot or an in-place sine motion as full-angle physical completion.
